decisions.reason: As a modular extension of the firm's core geospatial software components, it remains a cheap and strategically coherent option to keep open while demand across models continues to reveal itself.

The building data digital twin service fits the firm's longer-term direction and customer base, but because it is more delivery- and sales-intensive its prospects are still somewhat uncertain rather than clearly bad.
After another year and with adjacent identity-access offerings already pruned, this service looks less differentiated from standard solutions and no longer justifies keeping the option open.
This workshop builds directly on the firm's consulting and training strengths, is inexpensive to maintain, and is still too new to abandon without more market feedback.
